The first image is my hero's base body sheet: a bald chibi boy in 32 labelled poses, facing right. Keep every cell EXACTLY as it is except cells 9 RUN 1, 10 RUN 2, 11 RUN 3 and 12 RUN 4. Redraw those 4 cells as one clear 4-frame running loop, the same boy at the same size, facing right, in the same spot in each cell, with his feet on the same baseline as now:
- 9 RUN 1 (contact): his NEAR leg (the one closer to us) reaches forward, its foot planted flat on the ground ahead of him; his FAR leg stretches behind him, toes pushing off the ground.
- 10 RUN 2 (passing): his NEAR leg is straight under his body, foot planted on the ground; his FAR leg swings forward past it with the knee bent and lifted, foot off the ground.
- 11 RUN 3 (contact): the mirror of RUN 1 with the legs swapped: his FAR leg reaches forward, its foot planted flat on the ground ahead of him; his NEAR leg stretches behind him, toes pushing off.
- 12 RUN 4 (passing): the mirror of RUN 2: his FAR leg is straight under his body, foot planted; his NEAR leg swings forward with the knee bent and lifted.
- In every one of these 4 cells one foot is clearly flat on the ground, so he never looks like he is floating.
- Shade the FAR leg (and its foot and shorts leg) noticeably darker than the near leg, so the two legs are easy to tell apart.
- Arms: his front arm (on the right side of the figure) pumps with a bent elbow and a closed fist, as now. His back arm (on the LEFT side of the figure) stays bent at his side with the closed fist at hip height, a little in FRONT of his hip like in the WALK cells, NOT swung up or back behind him. Both fists stay empty and closed.
- He leans forward a little, like now. Same grey shorts, same bare feet and same colours as the other cells.

edit.text:
This image is a template for 7 parallax backdrop layers of DAWNHARBOR, a white-walled port town at sunrise, in my game's style: soft painted pixel art, warm gold light, plum-violet shade. Replace each WHITE strip with the layer named on it, filling that strip edge to edge and staying inside it: nothing may cross a strip's top or bottom edge, so make each layer only as tall as its strip. The 6 MAGENTA rows between the strips are gaps: leave them untouched, flat magenta #FF00FF, with nothing painted on them, not even sky.
1. FAR LAYER: sky from navy #1d2f5c at the top through blue #3f6aa0 and peach #f2a98a to cream #ffe0b0, over the open sea with a distant line of hazy blue islands. Fills its strip; seamless left to right.
2. MID LAYER: rooftops of the port, white walls and blue tiles stepping up a hill, on magenta (no sky behind them). Seamless left to right.
3. NEAR LAYER: the harbour front, ship masts, rigging and furled sails, on magenta (no sky behind them). Seamless left to right.
4. CLOUDS: 4 separate soft morning clouds, cream with peach undersides, on magenta.
5. LANDMARK: a tall white lighthouse on a rocky point with a sun-shaped lamp, on magenta.
6. SKY BODY: a low warm morning sun with a soft glow ring, on magenta.
7. MOTES: a scatter of sparkles like sun on water and a few distant gulls, on magenta.
Remove the white and the label text: in strips 2 to 7 everything that is not part of the layer becomes flat magenta #FF00FF.

6. SKY BODY: only the round orange moon, on flat magenta, with no clouds and no pink glow around it.

Replace the coral-reef titan with a new boss, the same creature in every frame: a hulking stone beast that came out of a rift of white light, as if from a world that is already gone. Repaint ONLY the stone wall between the top beam and the wainscot, on both sides of the post. Remove the two lattice windows and the red sun banners completely. Paint the wall as warm grey stone blocks with soot stains, lit by warm amber forge light. On each side of the post, one arched window with small iron-framed panes and a deep stone sill, showing a view of dark volcanic ridges under an orange dusk sky with drifting embers. Below each window, a plain stone wall; no shelves, no goods, nothing hanging. Everything is seen straight from the front, flat against the wall, with no perspective, no top faces and no side depth; nothing ends loose in mid-air. The left and right edges of the image must join seamlessly when the tile is repeated side by side. Paint in the same style as the second image and the rest of the wall: rich warm colours, strong light and shadow with bright highlights, visible painted texture at a fairly chunky brush scale, a thin dark outline. Painted, never pixel art. No letters or words. Same image size and layout.
